notes.title: Virgo VS The Zodiac at BitSummit 7 Spirits this weekend!
notes.notes:
A big hello to all the Degica fans out there!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33661629/7047f9a1426919c77856fd8e95014b89e8176c8b.jpg[/img]

We here at Degica Games are proud to announce our publishing partnership with Moonana the team behind the unforgiving timed action turn-based JRPG Virgo Vs The Zodiac! (VVTZ for short!)

Get ready to "Embark on a cosmic quest to follow your fate, or defy your destiny" this Autumn 2019.

Along with the news of our publishing partnership, Degica and Moonana will be attending Japan's largest Indie Game event, [url=https://bitsummit.org/en/][b]BitSummit 7 Spirits[/b][/url], from June 1st & 2nd at Miyako Messe in Kyoto. If you are in Kyoto come on by and check out the special Virgo Vs The Zodiac demo we will have on display and meet the Moonana team!

[h1]About Virgo VS The Zodiac:[/h1]
[b]Virgo Vs The Zodiac is a sci-fi/fantasy JRPG inspired by the Mario & Luigi RPG series and the Mother RPG series[/b] in which you play as an obsessed villain. The game features traditional turn-based combat with real-time execution of moves: blocking, countering and timing your attacks carefully as well as predicting your foes' moves is essential to succeed in [b]Virgo's twisted and unforgiving cosmic quest to bring back the Golden Age[/b], a period of peace, symmetry and balance, or so she thinks. In this galaxy where every action means a reaction, you’ll play as Virgo, the Holy Queen, often called Dreadful Queen by heretics, bringing mayhem to the Zodiac Realms and leaving a trail of stardust on the way, all to fit her excessively righteous worldview. 

[h1]Special Origins Interview:[/h1]
You can also get a glimpse into the beginnings of the game and how it came to be in this special interview article with the creator Nana.

http://blog.rpgmakerweb.com/interview/virgo-vs-the-zodiac/

[h1]BitSummit 7 Spirits[/h1]
Those who attend the event will be able to try out the exciting battle demo in either English or Japanese!
Attendees who have tried the demo will receive a random acrylic keychain of a character from Virgo Vs The Zodiac! 

For those who come to see us at our booth, we will be also handing out Steam keys for the BitSummit demo version, along with an original designed clear file! 
Supplies are limited so be sure to stop by!

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33661629/7fc0cfd37e8fea1c5b946f78ccbc986c997541a7.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33661629/01d7ba0480edf3f01a920ae04a502f8d75b11bc0.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Event Info[/h1]
We will be attending as "Degica Games"
Event Name：BitSummit 7 Spirits
Date：June 1st - June 2nd, 2019 
Time：10:00 ～ 17:00 
Venue：Kyoto International Exhibition Hall: MIYAKO MESSE 3rd Exhibition Hall, 3rd Floor
Organizer：BitSummit Organization Committee
[url=http://bitsummit.org/ ]BitSummit Homepage[/url]
We will announce our booth information on the[url=https://twitter.com/degicagames]DegicaGames Official[/url] Twitter account so give us a follow and stay tuned!
